plan.name: Read and retain saved draft evidence
plan.summary: Complete step 2 of parent #783 by loading factory-authenticated proposal_ref markers through the configured repository's existing GitHub GET reads and factory.Marker.ResolveDraft, checking the completed draft ref and reading only result.json at its immutable commit, then carrying the reference, complete validated proposal, original question snapshots and separate current answers into dashboard waiting state with retryable diagnostics and no ratify or choose controls for unresolved evidence, including recovery when comment timestamps have not changed. Publish the deterministic locator /draft/<owner>/<repository>/<issue>/<full-result-commit>/<64-lowercase-payload-digest> for an authenticated saved reference, redirecting with 302 and no-cache to a script-free /reader/<presentation-digest>.html page whose identity binds the reference, exact result bytes and current rendered contents, with an exact-byte downloadable /reader/<presentation-digest>.json response, complete readable record, candidate rules and bounds, TLC outcomes and tool/source identities, captured comparisons and qualifications, all question alternatives with their option evidence pages and prior-choice context, and the existing native SVG and animated/still posters or honest too_large explanation. Both public and /act Needs you cards link the same saved locator alongside their existing presentations, preserve the original ratification hash and authorized command path, and distinguish unresolved references from legacy chart-free proposals; extend the shared proposal/preview cache lifecycle for detached validation, rendering, atomic persistence and restart checks against retained factory-comment and completed-run authority, retaining authenticated records and locator authority independently of current cards so revision, answers, ratification or presentation eviction cannot retarget an old link, while failed reads, saves or snapshot replacement preserve published healthy evidence and damaged bytes cannot be resealed under their former identity. Saved routes accept GET and bodyless HEAD, refuse other methods, return explicit non-success diagnostics for missing or invalid evidence, restrict access to configured repositories and known factory accounts before blob reads, and use representation-bound ETags and existing script-free security headers; keep existing inline-marker eviction, sibling isolation, receipt recovery, author checks and poster behavior pinned by the current dashboard tests, and add genuine referenced-marker fixtures without weakening the existing fake GitHub command contract or changing publication size policy. Update SPEC.md, docs/dashboard.md and docs/statecharts.md for these routes, trust, complete evidence and retention, citing this ratified plan, #790's saved-reference plan and D-0049, D-0353, D-0355, D-0362, D-0368, D-0394 and D-0414, linking docs/factory.md for the shared reference contract; the merger records the durable-locator and record-retention refinement under D-0122, and this D-0105 build writes no decisions or modeled core changes.

tests.name: TestSavedDraft897ProposalRoundTrip
tests.says: A compact authenticated marker loads an oversized checked proposal through pinned GitHub reads into waiting state, both cards and complete script-free HTML, exact JSON and native images, with stable HTTP identities, cache reuse and restart.

tests.name: TestSavedDraft897QuestionSnapshots
tests.says: An oversized question retains every original alternative, baseline, exact wording and checked choice context while partial answers change only visible remaining forks and current answers, and all option evidence stays readable without ratification controls.

tests.name: TestSavedDraft897ComparisonsAndLimitations
tests.says: Referenced revisions present their complete captured comparisons and qualifications, and too_large records retain their checked counts and explanation without inventing images.

tests.name: TestSavedDraft897AuthorityAndRecovery
tests.says: Only the known factory account's matching reference authorizes reads and actions; substitutions and unavailable records give isolated diagnostics and recover without a comment timestamp change.

tests.name: TestSavedDraft897DurableLocatorsAndFailures
tests.says: Published locators survive revision, answers, ratification, failed saves and snapshot replacement, presentation eviction and offline restart, always resolving the original record.

tests.name: TestSavedDraft897RestartRejectsDamage
tests.says: Restart revalidates retained saved bytes and factory/repository authority, refuses damaged evidence without resealing it, preserves healthy siblings and recovers from the exact immutable source.
